optimizedDescription.value: IndexProjectGraph forwards prepared project indexing inputs to provider, managing force recreate and incompatibility repairs.

optimizedContext.value:
# IndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `IndexProjectGraph.execute(input)` MUST call `provider.index()` once with `IndexOptions` built from `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, optional `vcsRef`, `onProgress`, and force intent; return `IndexResult` unchanged.
- When `input.force === true`, forward `force: true` to `provider.index(...)`. NEVER call `provider.recreate()` directly; provider owns destructive reset, generation rotation, and lock policy.
- `IndexProjectGraphInput` MUST include opened `provider: CodeGraphProvider`, `projectRoot: string`, `workspaces: WorkspaceIndexTarget[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion: string`, `vcsRoot: string | null`; MAY include `vcsRef: string`, `force: boolean`, `onProgress: IndexProgressCallback`. Forward `vcsRoot` unchanged.
- Use case MUST NOT resolve workspaces, acquire locks, spawn subprocesses, or directly reset provider/store.
- `createIndexProjectGraph()` MUST return stateless `IndexProjectGraph`.
- Support provider-owned repair on schema/derivation incompatibility. Result MUST report if full rebuild occurred and stable rebuild reason (explicit force, backend schema incompatibility, derivation mismatch). Repair rotates storage generation; MUST NOT expose store ready until indexing and search-index rebuild complete.

## Constraints

- MUST NOT open/close provider.
- MUST NOT acquire/release graph indexing lock.
- Parse failures remain in `IndexResult.errors`; use case MUST NOT throw for per-file errors.
